ContactPoint.description:
A local or imported point. `sourceRecordId: null` identifies an explicit local value.
Preferred observations survive source refresh/deactivation, including their original value.

countryCode.description: Explicit ISO country context for national phone normalization; absent never implies a locale.

ContactPointInput.description: A point observation. Normalized match keys are computed by the server, never accepted as input.

countryCode.description: Explicit ISO country context for national phone normalization; absent never implies a locale.

ContactPointKind.description: A contact point's semantic kind; shared values never identify one person by themselves.

ContactPointListResponse.description: Contact point observations, including inactive audit values and preferred selections.

ContactPointResponse.description: A newly added explicit local point.

CreateEntityBody.description:
Body accepted by `POST /entities`. `type` defaults to `company`; the array
fields default to empty.

`colour` deliberately has no field here: it is never client-supplied, on
create or otherwise (POPS-3061 design correction). `entities::repo::create`
assigns one at random from the fixed palette in `entities::colours`, the
same way `avatar_asset_id`/`poster_asset_id` are absent and assigned
through their own dedicated write paths rather than this body.

Entity.description:
The wire shape served by every entities route. `notionId`, `ownerUri`, and
`ownerUriStaleAt` are deliberately NOT exposed (internal/integration
columns).

EntityLookup.description: Wire shape of one bulk-lookup entry.

EntityMutation.description: Create/update response body — the entity plus a human-readable message.

ErrorBody.description: Error envelope returned by every fallible contacts route.

ErrorCode.description: Stable error codes returned by the contacts pillar.

FieldSelection.description: Select a scalar value belonging to a retained entity in the resulting group.

HealthResponse.description:
`GET /health` response body. Field-for-field identical to the TS pillar
health envelope: `ok`, `status`, `pillar`, `version`, `ts` (an RFC 3339 /
ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, matching the TS `new Date().toISOString()`). The
registry health probe parses this shape across every pillar.

IdentityGroup.description: A canonical group and the directory-wide optimistic revision.

LookupBody.description:
`POST /entities/lookup` body. `fields` is reserved for a future field
selector. `ids`, when present and non-empty, narrows the match set to
those ids (POPS-3925) instead of the whole contact set; omitted or empty
keeps the original "answer everything" behaviour existing callers rely on.

excludePersons.description: Exclude persons only for explicitly merchant-scoped consumers.

LookupResponse.description:
`POST /entities/lookup` response — the whole contact set's match columns in
one round-trip, plus the fetch instant for the caller's in-run cache.

MergeBody.description:
Existing canonical groups to combine; member IDs must name their current roots.
Requested selections are validated before any redirect changes, never silently ignored.

MergeField.description: Scalar fields that can select a retained member's value without overwriting it.

MergeResult.description: The immutable result of a merge; retries return this original receipt.

MessageResponse.description: Bare `{ message }` body returned by delete.

NameCompleteness.description: Whether the source explicitly knows a name to be complete, incomplete, or unknown.

PaginationMeta.description: Pagination envelope returned by every list endpoint.

PersonName.description: A structured name; completeness is explicit and is never inferred from display text.

PersonProfile.description: Local name override, independent of imported source names and entity display names.

PersonProfileResponse.description: Local profile response; `null` means no local name override exists.

ResolveBody.description: Bounded IDs to resolve, preserving request order and repeated historical IDs.

ResolveResponse.description: A consistent directory snapshot. Batches may be combined only at the same revision.

ResolvedIdentity.description: A historical ID and its current canonical identity; null means the ID does not exist.

SearchHit.description: One ranked search hit. `uri` is the canonical `pops:contacts/contact/<id>`.

SearchRequest.description:
`POST /search` request body. `query.text` is the term; `context` is
accepted and ignored (parity with the orchestrator's wire shape).

SeparateBody.description: Persist or revoke an explicit keep-separate decision for stable member IDs.

SeparateList.description: All current separation decisions at a consistent directory revision.

SeparatePair.description: A current stable-member pair preventing direct and indirect merges.

SeparateResult.description: Result of an explicit separation decision.

SourceAccount.description: A provider account identity; `accountKey` is a stable provider subject, never a credential.

SourceAccountInput.description: Register a stable account namespace. Changing a display label does not change account identity.

SourceAccountResponse.description: Stable account namespace resulting from create-or-fetch registration.

SourceRecord.description: One namespaced external contact record attached to a canonical person entity.

SourceRecordListResponse.description: Active and inactive external records linked to a person.

UndoBody.description: Undo requires the exact untouched post-merge directory revision.

UndoResult.description: Undo restores directory membership. External references created after the merge remain unchanged.

UpdateEntityBody.description:
Body accepted by `PATCH /entities/:id`. Every field is optional; a present
field (even `null` for the nullable columns) is applied, an absent field is
left untouched. The nullable columns use `Option<Option<T>>` to tell
"absent" (outer `None` — leave the column alone) apart from "set to null"
(`Some(None)` — clear the column). serde collapses a JSON `null` into the
outer `None` by default, so those fields deserialize through
[`double_option`], which preserves the present-but-null case.

`colour` has no field here either, for the same reason it has none on
[`CreateEntityBody`]: a client may only reroll it, through the dedicated
`POST /entities/:id/colour/reroll` route, never set it to an arbitrary
string via this generic PATCH.
